tools.name: about_drmaker3d
tools.description: What DrMaker3D (drmaker3d.com) offers and how it works: a one-person 3D printing and 3D modeling studio in Burlington, Connecticut that ships across the U.S. Custom 3D printing with an instant online quote for STL, OBJ, 3MF and STEP files, design from a photo, sketch or idea, upfront-priced figures made from a photo or AI picture (one or two on a base, pets, wedding cake toppers), printing models from Printables, Thingiverse or MakerWorld links, CookieMaker3D custom cookie cutters, cake toppers, gifts with a gift finder, 3D printed lake maps, paying by invoice or tax exempt for schools and businesses, nine materials, made-to-order pendant lights, turnaround, shipping and how to order. Use it to answer questions about the studio: what it makes, from what, how long it takes and how ordering works.

topic.description: Which part to return; "all" for everything.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the DrMaker3D shop (pendant lights, sets, gifts, gift cards and other made-to-order products) and its service pages (a figure from a photo, a pet figure, a wedding cake topper figure, the cake topper and cookie cutter makers, lake maps, the gift finder, paying by invoice) by words. Returns titles, starting prices in U.S. dollars where available, and links. A catalog result includes a handle for get_product_offers and a delivery type. A custom print from a file has no product: use about_drmaker3d, print_price_examples or request_quote for those.

query.description: Words to match, e.g. "ribbed pendant" or "gift card". Empty lists the shop.

tools.name: get_product_offers
tools.description: Use the handle from search_products to find a public catalog product’s available variants, options, unit prices in USD cents and delivery type. Share the selected purchase_url with the shopper to open that variant on its storefront. For more variants, call again with pagination.next_offset as offset. Shipping, tax and optional customizations are determined on the site.

tools.name: print_price_examples
tools.description: Real prices from the DrMaker3D instant quote for three reference parts (a 2 in clip or knob, a 6 in enclosure, an 8 in housing) in each material, at Standard quality, 20% infill, one copy, before shipping. Use it to give a person a ballpark; the exact price comes from uploading their file at the instant quote page, or from a quote request. Also lists the upfront prices for a figure made from a person's photo or AI picture (4, 6 or 8 in tall, one color or full color, one figure or two on one base, keychains, sets; free shipping in the contiguous U.S. included; standing figures a range, keychains fixed; full color is up to 6 colors, extra colors cost more), ordered on its own page, and the prices of cake toppers, name keychains and photo lithophanes, each designed on its own page.

material.description: Optional material name, e.g. PLA, PETG, TPU, ABS, ASA, PC, PA-CF, PETG-CF, "Nylon (PA)". Omit for all.

tools.name: print_options
tools.description: The materials, colors (in stock or special order), print qualities, infill and copy limits, largest one-piece size and accepted file formats of the DrMaker3D instant quote, and how to upload a model file for quote_custom_print. Call it before quote_custom_print so the material and color named are real ones.

tools.name: quote_custom_print
tools.description: Prices a 3D model using the DrMaker3D engine. Give the attached file as file, or send the key from POST /api/upload (kind=printiq; STL, OBJ, 3MF, GLB, glTF or PLY up to 25 MB). Read quote_status: final includes checkout_item, estimate needs confirmation on the website, studio_review needs Rich to check it, and unavailable needs corrected input or a retry. Only final prices can proceed to create_checkout. Use request_quote with permission to send a review request.

file_key.description: The key POST /api/upload returned (starts with "printiq/"). Give this or file.

file.description: The person's model file as ChatGPT passes an attached file (a link on files.oaiusercontent.com or OpenAI’s own file storage). Give this or file_key.

material.description: A material from print_options, e.g. PLA, PETG, "TPU (flexible)", ABS, ASA, "Nylon (PA)", PC, PA-CF, PETG-CF.

color.description: A color of that material from print_options, e.g. "Black" or "Matte Charcoal".

finish.description: Optional color family, e.g. "PLA Matte", when a color name is in two families.

quality.description: Default standard. Draft only for parts 100 mm or more across.

infill.description: Percent, default 15. 50 and up for functional parts.

copies.description: How many of the model, default 1.

units.description: Default mm. "inches" for an STL or OBJ drawn in inches.

email.description: The person's own email, supplied with permission. Required when the instant-price email gate is enabled; never invent an address.

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: Creates a Stripe Checkout link for one or more custom prints with a final quote_status from quote_custom_print, for the person to open and pay in a browser. Nothing is charged by this tool and no order exists until the person pays. Each print is priced again on the server (send checkout_item as quote_custom_print returned it; prices are never taken from the request). Needs the destination ZIP (or country and postal code), since shipping is priced to it. Returns order_link, a drmaker3d.com page that shows the order and opens a fresh payment page, good for 7 days: give the person that. checkout_url is the Stripe page itself, good for two hours. Catalog products, figures, keychains, lithophanes, cake toppers and cookie cutters are bought on their own pages: give the person that page from search_products or print_price_examples.

zip.description: U.S. ZIP code it ships to.

email.description: The person's own email, supplied with permission. Required when the instant-price email gate is enabled; never invent an address.

agent.description: Optional: the name of your agent or service.

tools.name: track_order
tools.description: The stage of a DrMaker3D order (received, printing, finishing, shipped, delivered), its ship-by day and arrival window, and tracking when shipped. Needs the order number (like DM1015) and the email the order was placed with; only that order is ever returned.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Send a quote request to Rich at DrMaker3D for a person who wants something 3D printed or designed. Only with the person's permission, and only with their own name and email: Rich replies to that email, within one business day, with a price and a link to pay online (the person pays in a browser; nothing is charged here). Describe what it is, its size, material or color if known, how many, and when it is needed. A file is optional: give a public share link to an STL, OBJ, 3MF or STEP file, or a Printables, Thingiverse or MakerWorld model link; with no file, describe it (with measurements) and it is designed and printed, quoted together.

email.description: The person's own email address, where Rich will reply.

description.description: What they want made, its size, use, material or color, quantity and deadline.

file_url.description: Optional public link to the 3D file or model page.

file_key.description: Optional: the key POST /api/upload returned for the file (kind printiq or printiq-manual), e.g. the one quote_custom_print sent here for a hand quote.

requested_material.description: Optional special-order material ID from print_options.manual_quote_materials. Requires a manual quote; never an instant-price material.

zip.description: Optional U.S. ZIP or country, for shipping.
